sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and a one-time flag
sections.what: Brings in the drawing library, React and the house colours, and sets a flag so setup runs only once.
sections.why: Needed for drawing and to avoid repeated setup.

sections.name: initMermaid
sections.title: One-time drawing setup
sections.what: Sets fonts, colours, spacing and strict security once for the whole app.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps diagrams in house style with one setup.
sections.watch_out: Setup runs once, so colour changes need a page reload to take effect.

sections.name: MermaidDiagramProps
sections.title: Settings for a diagram
sections.what: Lists the diagram text and an optional id.

sections.name: MermaidDiagram
sections.title: Draw and display a diagram
sections.what: Renders the text whenever it changes, places the picture in the container, and shows a placeholder if rendering fails.
sections.why: Likely reason: drawing is asynchronous so the page stays responsive.
sections.watch_out: Each render gets an id built from the current time, and only failed renders are cleaned up, so old pieces may remain after changes.

summary: Draws a flowchart from a text description into a picture on the page, or shows a placeholder when drawing fails.
why: Likely reason: diagrams are kept as text and drawn in the browser.
how: Sets up the drawing library once with house colours and strict security. Whenever the text changes, it renders the text into a picture, places it in the container, and shows an unavailable box if rendering fails.
inputs: The diagram text and an optional id.
outputs: A diagram, or an unavailable box.
risks: The picture is inserted as raw page content, so the strict security setting must stay on. A failure shows only a generic placeholder, not the reason.
debug: If the box says unavailable, check the diagram text for syntax errors and read the browser console.
